svg.title: Point counts on a fixed 10 × 10 grid
svg.desc: The left panel shows the first of 100 independent trials. Each trial places 400 uniform points in a 100 by 100 square on a fixed 10 by 10 grid. The right panel shows total frequencies across all 10,000 cells. Open circles show expected frequencies for a Poisson distribution with mean 4, scaled to 10,000 cells. A dashed curve uses the gamma function to extend the reference smoothly between integers.
svg.metadata: Python random.Random seed: 42. Trials: 100. Points per trial: 400. Domain: 100 by 100. Grid: 10 by 10.
